title: Non-Key Share Bound in Adaptive Probing
summary: Full-model security is proved with twice the parameter t plus one shares, a bound optimal for secret-key shares; whether t plus one shares suffice for non-key variables remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether $n=t+1$ shares suffice for non-key variables under the full adaptive probing model.

scope.domain: Higher-order masking of look-up tables against side-channel probing attacks.
assumptions: Security is considered under the full adaptive probing model.
parameters: t: order parameter in the proved and proposed share bounds
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether n = t + 1 shares suffice for non-key variables under the full adaptive probing model.

citations.label: Higher Order Masking of Look-Up Tables

progress.summary: The paper proves full-model security with at least twice t plus one shares and identifies this bound as optimal for secret-key shares. It leaves open whether t plus one shares suffice for other variables.
citation_labels: Jean-Sébastien Coron et al., Higher Order Masking of Look-Up Tables
